audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose framed Karma as a burst champion ('His burst window is real', 'while his burst is loaded'). Karma is a poke/sustain/peel mage with no burst pattern, and every third-person pronoun on the page is male for a female champion.
audit.why: Enemy kit: Inner Flame (Q) 950 range poke, Focused Resolve (W) 675 tether root, Inspire (E) shield + move speed, Mantra (R) empowerment. Nothing in the kit bursts; the lane is lost to poke plus a root that pins you out of Astral Flight. champ-gender.js lists karma as female.
audit.corrected: Reframed as a poke-and-tether lane: early levels are a tax, the danger is standing inside 675 with Astral Flight down, and all pronouns corrected to she/her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart layers disagreed: full phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[4]='Karma', win[5]/win[6]='Aurelion Sol'. Packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row. Three rows rendered two different answers. Packet levelChart is [Karma x5, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol]; the 51.13% win rate over 1148 games and the scaling profile support Karma owning level 6 (Mantra-Inspire shield + move speed peels the Falling Star dive) and Aurelion Sol taking over from first item.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Karma, phases[5].side -> Aurelion Sol, phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, proposed as one atomic group; phases[4].why rewritten to match the Karma verdict. phases[5].why and phases[6].why already describe the owner winning, so they stay.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] called Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'a global burst play'. Falling Star has 1250 range and a 120/110/100s cooldown; it is not global.
audit.why: Owner kit R: range 1250, cd 120/110/100. Several content fields also described a pre-rework 'star orbit' that no longer exists in the kit (Breath of Light is a 750-range channelled beam).
audit.corrected: Replaced 'stars orbit'/'global ultimate' language throughout content with Breath of Light, E executes, Falling Star and The Skies Descend, and put the real 120s cooldown into the spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if the link is NOT broken, and while rooted you cannot cast Astral Flight — your only escape.
audit.why: Enemy W text: 'Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted'. Range 675, cooldown 12 flat at every rank. Owner W Astral Flight is a movement ability at 1500 range with a 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 cooldown, so flying the moment the tether lands breaks the 675 link before the root resolves; being rooted first denies the cast entirely. Mantra Bonus on W also heals Karma and extends the root, which is the anti-heal trigger flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: Stated across cooldowns, dos/donts, report[5], phases[3].why and wants: fly early to break 675, and bring Grievous Wounds before extended trades because Mantra-Focused Resolve heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two wrong ability names in the content layer: whys[2] said 'Her Q root' (Inner Flame is not a root — Focused Resolve, the W, is), and mid + wants.foe[1] said 'Mantra-Renewal' (Karma's E is Inspire; there is no Renewal in this kit).
audit.why: Enemy kit slots: Q Inner Flame (projectile, slow), W Focused Resolve (hardCC root, heal on Mantra), E Inspire (shield), R Mantra.
audit.corrected: whys[2] now names the W tether; mid and wants.foe[1] now name Mantra-Inspire (shield/speed) and Mantra-Focused Resolve (heal/extended root) correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12 seconds flat at every rank, not 15. Inner Flame is 9/8/7/6/5. Astral Flight is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16. Mantra is 40/38/36/34.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now lists the real per-rank numbers and dosFull[2].d says 12 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d ('Hold R as the anti-dive stun post-6') carried the tradeGood string verbatim, and dontsFull[2].d ('Trade HP for stacks below half health') carried the tradeBad string verbatim.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 2 — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in Falling Star's 120s cooldown and Mantra-Focused Resolve's heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Templated fields with only the enemy name swapped: enemyWin ('wins by landing X, denying your pattern'), ahead, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d.
audit.why: Template sweep — each of these reads identically across matchups with a different ability name pasted in.
audit.corrected: All rewritten against Karma's actual numbers (675 tether, 12s, 950 Inner Flame, Mantra-Inspire peel) within the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Packet suspectNames flagged 'Focused Resolve's' in whys[0] as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE; Focused Resolve is Karma's real W. The genuine name errors were 'Her Q root' (whys[2]) and 'Mantra-Renewal' (mid, wants.foe[1]) — Karma's E is Inspire. Also fixed a pre-rework kit description: multiple content fields described an orbiting-stars Aurelion Sol that no longer exists. Level chart: full phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' against content win[] of Karma/Aurelion Sol/Aurelion Sol and against packet.levelChart; fixed the full layer to match, and rewrote phases[4].why to match the Karma verdict. I did NOT assert that Karma's root interrupts the Breath of Light channel — Riot's text does not say roots interrupt channels and the kit's channel flag is derived, so I only claimed the verifiable part: rooted, you cannot cast Astral Flight, and the tether does not root at all if you break 675 first.
